what_this_tests: comparable end-to-end QUALITY, not reproduction and NOT the weights in isolation. The official checkpoints were calibrated on Qwen's data rather than our ultrachat_200k 512x2048, AND vLLM dispatches each checkpoint through the kernel its own config selects, so the two sides take different kernel paths (R32.1). H8 puts the served-path contribution at 0.2-1.6 pp, so the +/-2.0 pp band is largely consumed by it and a PASS means only 'no gross calibration error at this resolution' (R31).
